Please provide these details so I can give you an accurate assessment of your eligibility for Child Benefit for each child.

Even though Alex doesn't live with you, you are eligible for Child Benefit because you contribute £26.05 per week towards Alex's upkeep, which meets the contribution threshold. No one else is claiming for Alex.

You are eligible for Child Benefit for Blake because Blake lives with you and is under 16 years old.

### ❌ **Charlie - INELIGIBLE**
Unfortunately, you cannot claim Child Benefit for Charlie because someone else who lives with Charlie is already claiming it. Only one person can receive Child Benefit for the same child.

**Important note:** If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may have to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge, even if you're eligible to claim.

If you'd like to discuss your options regarding Charlie, or if you have any other questions about claiming Child Benefit for Alex and Blake, please let me know!
